i947.title: Forge interface, first half: the trait and a labels-backed GitHub adapter in console/core
i947.body:
Part 2 of #800, first half: the forge interface and its GitHub adapter as a library, with no callers yet. A second issue gives bash a command for it, and a third moves `libexec/tidy`, `libexec/status` and `lib/labels.sh` onto that command (#810). Nothing in the dispatcher changes here.

## Deliverables

1. `console/core/src/forge.rs`, a new module, exported from `console/core/src/lib.rs`: a trait `Forge` in tehas terms, not GitHub's. [paths: `console/core/src/forge.rs`, `console/core/src/lib.rs`]
   - `labels(issue)`: the labels an issue carries.
   - `label_state(issue, label)`: the newest `labeled` or `unlabeled` event of that label, with its account and time, or none.
   - `approval(issue)`: who applied `tehas:ready` most recently, and when, as `lib/labels.sh`'s `tehas_label_actor` answers it.
   - `add_label(issue, label)` and `remove_label(issue, label)`.
   Errors are values (`ForgeError`, naming the call and gh's first error words), never panics.
2. `console/core/src/forge.rs`: `GitHub`, the adapter, backing every term with labels as today. It reads label events from the REST list with `--paginate`, so an issue past 100 events is read whole. It runs gh through a small trait of its own (`GhRunner`: run gh with arguments, get stdout or an error), so tests run without gh or a network. [paths: `console/core/src/forge.rs`]
3. Tests beside the source, with a stub `GhRunner`: an approval read from two pages of events; a label added and then removed reads as `unlabeled`; two events in the same second keep their order; a failed gh call is an error value. [paths: `console/core/src/forge.rs`]

## Acceptance criteria

- The new tests pass; `cargo test --locked -p tehas-core` passes otherwise unchanged.
- No file under `bin/`, `lib/`, `libexec/` or `console/dispatch/` changes.
- `scripts/verify.sh --changed` passes.

## How to work on it

Build and test only this package: `cargo test --locked -p tehas-core`. Run `scripts/verify.sh --changed` once, at the end.

## Out of scope

- A binary or `tehasbot` command for it, and any caller: the next issues of #810.
- Native fields (blocked-by, Priority, issue types): parts 3 to 5 of #800.
